results.title: Mountain Brook council to hold public hearing on rezoning for townhomes
results.description: The City Council has a work session at 6:30 p.m. and action meeting at 7 p.m. Monday, July 27.

results.title: Trump touts US nuclear revival
results.description: "America is building again. America is dreaming again, and we're leading the world in pioneering the next generation of nuclear power and there's nobody even close," Trump said.
